sloka: तथा ब्रुवति शत्रुघ्ने राघवः पुनरब्रवीत् ।एवं भवतु काकुत्स्थ क्रियतां मम शासनम् ।। ७.६२.१५ ॥
transliteration: tathā bruvati śatrughne rāghavaḥ punarabravīt ।evaṁ bhavatu kākutstha kriyatāṁ mama śāsanam ।। 7.62.15 ॥

translations.english: While Shatrughna was speaking thus, Rama again said, "So be it, O Kakutstha; let my command be carried out."
